paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groupings, shown on the x-axis representing different layers with labels "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis, labeled "Relative Change", is linear with a range from -25% to 5%, with tick marks at -25%, -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. A yellow line with circle markers represents "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", starting at 0% at "Layer1-4" and remaining steady across layers, experiencing a slight dip below 0% at "Layer13-20". A red line with square markers represents "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit", starting at 0% at "Layer1-4", showing a similar trend with a small dip around "Layer13-20". A light blue line with circle markers represents "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit", starting near -2% at "Layer1-4", decreasing to around -12% at "Layer13-20", and then rising back towards -2%. A dark blue line with square markers represents "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit", starting above -5% at "Layer1-4", dipping to about -25% at "Layer13-20", and increasing back to near -5% by "Layer29-32". Additionally, a gray dashed line labeled "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" is constant at 0% across all layers.
